class.name: NetwPropertySetBinding
class.brief_description: One live binding of a [NetwPropertySet] to the node that declares it through [method Netw.configure_property], the route-keyed gather source for a state or input group.
class.description: The shell captures [member route], [member comp], and [member order_key] at registration. The set carries the wire contract, while the binding carries the live gather state: the two lanes' rows, the windowed input ring, and the row each lane last merged a frame onto. A set's [constant NetwPropertySet.VOLATILE] fields ride the SYNC_ROW channel freshest-wins, and its [constant NetwPropertySet.RETAINED] fields ride the reliable SYNC_ROW_DELTA lane only when they change, so the two lanes of one set never re-send each other. Both lanes offer the whole row every pass and neither decides what a recipient is owed. The send plane holds one baseline per peer per lane and answers with the columns that moved, which is why a binding carries no per-peer book of its own.

method.name: carry_channel_of
method.description: Returns the sibling channel a recovery advances [param property] along, or an empty [StringName] when it is restored at the acknowledged value.

method.name: converge_stiffness_of
method.description: Returns how firmly a recovery pulls [param property] toward the authoritative value, or [code]0.0[/code] when it is restored outright.

method.name: epsilon_override_of
method.description: Returns [param property]'s own divergence threshold, or a negative value when it inherits the entity's default.

method.name: field_of
method.description: Returns the declared [NetwPropertySetColumn] for [param property], or [code]null[/code] when this set does not carry it.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the node is alive, in the tree, and holds authority over the stream.

method.name: is_windowed
method.description: Returns whether this binding's volatile lane rides the redundant sample ring rather than a single row, which is what routes it onto the SYNC_ROW_WINDOW channel.

method.name: node
method.description: Returns the declaring node, or [code]null[/code] once it has freed.

method.name: property_class_of
method.description: Returns what [param property] does in the simulation, or [constant NetwPropertySet.CAUSAL] when the set does not declare it. A reconciliation reads this to decide which values it may compare and restore. Undeclared properties answer causal because that is the class whose mistake is a correction rather than a silent divergence.

method.name: reconcile_only_of
method.description: Returns whether [param property] is excluded from triggering a correction on its own.

method.name: teleport_at_of
method.description: Returns [param property]'s own teleport-tier distance, or a negative value when it inherits the entity's default.

method.name: teleport_only_of
method.description: Returns whether [param property] is restored only by a teleport-tier recovery.

members.member: Registered component address under the entity root.

Called after a frame applies, with the decoded header [code]{ordinal, tick, ack, payload, samples?}[/code]. A prediction engine subscribes here so a state receive drives reconciliation and an input receive opens the consume cursor, the way the synchronizer callbacks did. Unset for a plain display set, which just snaps the node.
Stable registration key used by the session's declaration table.
Cached entity route. A zero value has not bound to liveness yet.
The declaration this binding is a live instance of.
